partners.meta_title: Partners — Short supply chain. No compromise.
partners.meta_description: moroww only works with Belgian and European brands that share our standard. Including Moro Essentials for bathroom products.
partners.label: Our partners
partners.hero_body: moroww deliberately chooses Belgian and European brands that share our standard. Not because we have to — because it fits.
partners.moro_body: The bathroom is the first test. Guests feel it immediately: cheap soap in a plastic bottle tells a story — and not a good one. That is why we chose Moro Essentials, a Belgian brand that rethinks skincare from honesty. No unnecessary ingredients, no generic scents, no mass market. Just products that work, smell good and match who we are. In every moroww home. No exception.
partners.cleaners_body: Every moroww home is professionally prepared according to a fixed protocol. We only work with cleaning partners who know our standard, follow our checklist and share the same attention to detail. Belgian companies, short communication lines, no surprises.
partners.locals_body: In every region where moroww is active, we seek contact with local bakers, butchers, caterers and wineries. Guests who want to know where to find the best of the region find it through moroww. No guides, no sponsored lists — only addresses we stand behind ourselves.
partners.cta_body: We are looking for Belgian and European brands that put quality and honesty first. No mass market. No compromise.

theshore.meta_title: the shore — holiday homes on the Belgian coast
theshore.meta_description: Two moroww homes on the Belgian coast: Nosso Logies in Heist-aan-Zee and The Sixteenth in Ostend. Both certified.
theshore.hero_h1: where the light comes off the water.
theshore.hero_intro: Two houses on the Belgian coast, both within walking distance of the beach and both far enough from the crowds that you hear none of it in the morning. The coast is not a season. In February it is emptier, quieter and sharper than in July, and that is exactly when a house does the most.
theshore.streek_p1: What the coast does to a stay has little to do with the beach. It is the light: low, white and changeable, and it alters how a living room feels from one hour to the next. That is why, in a coastal house, we look at the windows before we look at the distance to the water.
theshore.streek_p2: The two houses in the shore are in Heist-aan-Zee and in Ostend. The first on a quiet street behind the dyke, with its own courtyard. The second on the sixteenth floor, with the sea on the horizon and the city below you.
theshore.streek_p3: That is an exception to our own rule, and we would rather say so ourselves. The standard asks for a quiet setting and no busy city centre. A flat sixteen floors up in Ostend passes that gate because the height does what distance does elsewhere: above the sixth floor you no longer hear the city. Anyone who is not convinced by that is better off booking in the fields.
theshore.streek_p4: The shoulder season is underrated on the coast. From January to March it is quiet, the light is at its best, and the restaurants that stay open all year are the good ones.

thefields.meta_title: the fields — holiday homes in the Flemish countryside
thefields.meta_description: Four moroww homes in the Flemish countryside: Meetjesland, Bulskampveld, Bruges hinterland and the Flemish Ardennes. Each certified.
thefields.hero_h1: where the fields end and the forest begins.
thefields.hero_intro: Four houses in the Flemish countryside: in the Meetjesland, the Bulskampveld, the Bruges hinterland and the Flemish Ardennes. What they share is not the region but the quiet — the kind of quiet in which you feel your shoulders drop.
thefields.streek_p1: The countryside between Ghent, Bruges and the Scheldt is not a tourist destination, and that is precisely why it works. There is no promenade, no season and no traffic. There are fields that turn into woodland, walking and cycling routes that begin at the front door, and villages where the baker opens at seven.
thefields.streek_p2: The four houses are spread out. Chalet Anna-Helena in Ursel, on the edge of the woods in the Meetjesland. The Cozy Relax Home in Beernem, with a pool and hot tub, against the Bulskampveld. De Lammersdamhoeve in Wingene, where the Bruges hinterland begins. And Sophora in Elst near Brakel, in the hills of the Flemish Ardennes.
thefields.streek_p3: Four regions, one kind of house: large enough to be together without being on top of one another, and quiet enough that you notice your ears adjusting. All four have a view of green from the living space. That is not chance but one of the four gates.
thefields.streek_p4: Those who know the shoulder season book here in November and in February. Outside it is bare and inside it is warm, and that is the reason these houses exist.

morowwos.meta_title: moroww-os — the system that runs the house
morowwos.meta_description: moroww-os runs the lock, the light, the temperature, the music, the scent, the noise limit and leak detection. One system, per moroww home.
morowwos.hero_intro: Not an app the owner has to operate, not staff who have to come by.
morowwos.body_p1: The lock, the light, the temperature, the music, the scent, the noise limit, leak detection. In a moroww home these do not stand apart, and they do not depend on a member of staff. They talk to each other.
morowwos.body_p2: A booking comes in and the house prepares itself. The heating is up to temperature in time. The lights are set. The scent of the collection is already there. This guest's code works from three in the afternoon and not after. If something goes wrong — a leak, smoke, a climate that drifts, sound above the limit — the system notices before anyone does.
morowwos.body_p3: The guest arrives in a house that knew they were coming. Nobody needs to come by for that. That is not less service. It is service that happens beforehand, so that the stay is entirely the guest's.
morowwos.loop_intro: What happens between booking and review, without anyone running it.
morowwos.cta_body: moroww installs the full system in your home and runs it remotely. You do not have to do anything to it — and you do not need to be able to. The standard is enforced by the system, not by goodwill.
morowwos.home_body: The lock, the light, the temperature, the music, the scent, the noise limit, leak detection. In a moroww home these do not stand apart, and they do not depend on a member of staff. They talk to each other.

destandaard.meta_title: The standard — four gates, one inspection
destandaard.meta_description: moroww looked at 350 homes. Seven met the standard. Four gates, a physical inspection, every year again.
destandaard.hero_h1: we say no more often than yes.
destandaard.hero_intro: A mark of approval that lets almost everyone in is not a mark of approval. The value of moroww is not in the houses that are in the collection, but in the houses that are not.
destandaard.gates_intro: Four conditions. All four, or the house does not come in. There is no weighting and there are no exceptions.
destandaard.gate01_body: With a minimum of two bedrooms. A house needs room to withdraw into. Otherwise it is a flat with a good view.
destandaard.gate02_body: Visible natural materials. At least one authentic architectural element. A view of green or water from the living space. All three, or the property fails. This is the only gate where taste plays a part, which is why it is defined the most tightly.
destandaard.gate03_body: Nature, coast, or a region where it is calm. No busy city centre. What you hear when you open the window in the morning decides how the day starts.
destandaard.gate04_body: Every house is visited in person by our team before it enters the collection. No approval by photograph, no video tour, no exceptions. One of us has stood in those rooms.
destandaard.visit_title: what happens before a house is accepted
destandaard.visit_p1: We come by and walk the house the way a guest would: from the drive to the front door, along the hallway, into the living space, every bedroom, every bathroom, the garden.
destandaard.visit_p2: We look at what stays. Materials, light, layout, sound, the condition of the things you only notice on day three. Not at what could be styled.
destandaard.visit_p3: We also write down what is not right. That does not disappear from the description if the house is accepted — it goes into it. A bedroom you walk through to reach another, a steep staircase, a terrace that only catches sun in the afternoon: we would rather tell you before you book than after.
destandaard.visit_p4: And for every house in the collection we explain why it passed. That is on the page of the house itself, in our own words.
destandaard.add_title: the standard does not stop at the inspection.
destandaard.add_intro1: The four gates are about what the house brings. The rest we bring.
destandaard.add_intro2: Every moroww home runs on moroww-os. Not an app the owner has to operate, and not staff who have to come by. The system runs the house itself: a booking comes in and the house prepares.
destandaard.add_lock_body: Your own code, valid from your arrival time and not after. No key, no appointment, no waiting for someone to come by.
destandaard.add_ambient_body: The heating is up to temperature in time. The lights are set. Music is playing when you walk in — or not, if you would rather it wasn't.
destandaard.add_scent_body: Each collection has its own signature scent: one for the shore, one for the fields. The diffusers are ours. We supply them, replace them and maintain them, so a house smells the way it should and not the way the last clean did.
destandaard.add_limit_body: A decibel meter watches that it stays quiet. It measures sound level, not conversation. Nothing is recorded and nobody is listening in. It exists to protect the neighbours and the owner's licence, not to follow you.
destandaard.add_invisible_body: A water leak, smoke, a climate that drifts: the system notices before anyone does.
destandaard.add_ordinary_body: Beds are made, linen is ready, everything is in place before you arrive.
destandaard.add_closing: That is not less service. It is service that happens beforehand, so that the stay is entirely yours.
destandaard.add_link: read how moroww-os runs the house
destandaard.reaudit_p1: An inspection that happens once is a moment. We come back every year.
destandaard.reaudit_p2: We look at the house and at the systems. A lock that plays up or a diffuser running empty is as much a shortcoming as a wall that no longer holds up.
destandaard.reaudit_p3: If a house no longer meets the standard, the owner has thirty days to put it right. If that does not happen, the house leaves the collection. Even if it rents well. Even if it costs us money.
destandaard.reaudit_p4: That is not a threat aimed at owners. It is the only reason the label is worth anything — to them as well.
destandaard.guest_title: you do not have to hope.
destandaard.guest_body: That is the whole point. No lottery, no edited photographs, no surprise on arrival. Someone went to look, and that someone had an interest in saying no.
destandaard.owner_title: do you think your house meets the standard?
destandaard.owner_body: Put it forward. We get in touch personally within 48 hours, and we come and see it ourselves.

about.market_p2: hosts want passive income. they get operational burden.
about.what_body_before: The owner provides the property. moroww delivers the experience. We certify, install and uphold the standard - on every home in
about.check_3: the quality label the market was missing
about.promise_intro: Every system exists for one reason: so you don't have to arrange anything and can just be.
about.systeem_01_tekst: Every home is physically visited before listing. What you see in the photo is what you find on arrival. No surprises. No lottery.
about.systeem_02_tekst: On arrival you scan a QR code. Check-in, house rules, local tips - in your language. The home is ready. No waiting. No explanation needed.
about.systeem_03_titel: the feeling is in the details
about.systeem_03_tekst: Scent, light, atmosphere. Not by chance - designed. Every home has its own sensory profile. The feeling you get is not luck.
about.systeem_04_titel: the standard doesn't stop at listing
about.systeem_04_tekst: Homes are monitored. Those who no longer meet the bar leave the collection. Your next stay is as good as your last.
about.standaard_h2: we say no more often than yes.
about.founders_owner_cta: discover how moroww works for owners
about.founders_p1: moroww is being built by Noam. What started as a frustration with the rental market became a label with a standard that doesn't bend. Not the largest collection, but the most curated.
about.founders_p3: Built on the belief that one flawless home is worth more than a hundred anonymous ones.
about.story_p1: moroww began in a flat in Edinburgh.
about.story_p2: In the photos, a view of the castle. In reality, mould. Everywhere you can think of.
about.story_p3: We complained to the booking platform. Rejected. The property is still online today. With good reviews.
about.story_p4: We were already working in holiday rentals at the time, and had always assumed the problem was management. That it was badly organised. It isn't.
about.story_p5: The problem is that nobody stands in between. There is no filter. Anyone can list, and nobody ever goes to look.
about.story_p6: In every sector where quality matters, there is a mark of approval. Restaurants have one. Hotels have one. Even eggs have one.
about.story_p8: That is what we are building.
about.oprichter_p1: Noam started out as a postman. Then sales, account management, business development, consultancy, and serving an American market from Belgium.
about.oprichter_p2: What he learned along the way: how to read people, how to turn problems into systems, and how to teach himself whatever he needed.
about.oprichter_p3: He builds moroww full time. Below market salary. Skin in the game.
about.cta_body: Are you the owner of a home that meets the standard? Or are you looking for a stay without the lottery?

owner.hero_body: moroww installs the technology, upholds the standard and manages the booking. You manage your own home.
owner.tech_body: The six components below form that system. moroww installs it and runs it remotely. You don't have to think about it.
owner.sys_01_tekst: Keyless arrival via unique code per booking. No key handover. No appointments. The guest enters. You don't need to be there.
owner.sys_02_tekst: A decibel sensor monitors your home without invading privacy. Nuisance is detected before it becomes a problem. Your licence stays safe.
owner.sys_03_tekst: Light, temperature and music are ready on arrival. The home welcomes the guest. Without you doing a thing.
owner.sys_04_tekst: moroww delivers and maintains the scent as part of the tech and scent subscription. You won't notice a thing.
owner.sys_05_tekst: Water leak, smoke, climate deviation - you're notified before there's damage. A system that watches while you sleep.
owner.sys_06_tekst: Occupancy, bookings, home status and monthly reporting in real time. Always insight. Never admin burden.
owner.fp_body: moroww is at the beginning. The first owners help build the label. That has a different value than joining when the label is already established.
owner.fp_01_tekst: Your commission rate of 15% is locked for the full first contract cycle of twelve months.
owner.fp_02_tekst: You work directly with the founders. No call centre. No intermediary.
owner.fp_03_tekst: Your home is listed first, promoted first and connected to our guest pipeline.
owner.fp_04_tekst: The stronger the moroww label becomes, the more your home benefits from it.
owner.stap_01_tekst: You fill in the form. We contact you personally within 48h. Every home is assessed on location, size and atmosphere.
owner.stap_02_tekst: Our team visits your home. We conduct the certification audit, give interior advice and install the full tech stack.
owner.stap_03_tekst: Your home carries the moroww label. We start distribution across all channels and via book.moroww.com. You track everything via the host dashboard.
owner.team_p1: You work with Noam. No call centre, no account manager, no intermediary. The founder comes to see the property himself and stays your point of contact.
owner.form_body: We contact you personally within 48h. Every home is physically assessed.
